# Data Source: stripe_invoice_rendering_template

A template, made in the Stripe Dashboard, that sets how invoices look. Look one up by its `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_invoice_rendering_template" "branded" {
  id = "inrtem_123"
}

output "template_version" {
  value = data.stripe_invoice_rendering_template.branded.version
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the invoice rendering template to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `metadata` - Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
* `nickname` - A brief description of the template, hidden from customers
* `status` - The status of the template, one of `active` or `archived`. Possible values: `active`, `archived`.
* `version` - Version of this template; version increases by one when an update on the template changes any field that controls invoice rendering
